import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    private static int[][] cap;
    private static int[] vis;
    private static int iter = 3;

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        int t = sc.nextInt();
        sc.nextLine(); // consume newline

        char[][] scien = new char[n + 1][n + 1];
        char[][] reac = new char[n + 1][n + 1];

        int infx = 0, infy = 0;

        // read scien grid
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            String line = sc.next();
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                scien[i][j] = line.charAt(j - 1);
                if (scien[i][j] == 'Z') {
                    infx = i;
                    infy = j;
                }
            }
        }

        // read reac grid
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            String line = sc.next();
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                reac[i][j] = line.charAt(j - 1);
            }
        }

        // shortest distances
        int INF = 1000000000;
        int[][][][] shortest = new int[n + 1][n + 1][n + 1][n + 1];
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                for (int k = 1; k <= n; k++) {
                    for (int l = 1; l <= n; l++) {
                        shortest[i][j][k][l] = INF;
                    }
                }
                shortest[i][j][i][j] = 0;
            }
        }

        int[] dx = {1, 0, -1, 0};
        int[] dy = {0, 1, 0, -1};

        // set adjacent edges
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                for (int k = 0; k < 4; k++) {
                    int ni = i + dx[k];
                    int nj = j + dy[k];
                    if (ni >= 1 && ni <= n && nj >= 1 && nj <= n) {
                        if (scien[i][j] != 'Y' && scien[ni][nj] != 'Y') {
                            shortest[i][j][ni][nj] = 1;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        // Floyd-Warshall all-pairs shortest path
        for (int ki = 1; ki <= n; ki++) {
            for (int kj = 1; kj <= n; kj++) {
                for (int ii = 1; ii <= n; ii++) {
                    for (int ij = 1; ij <= n; ij++) {
                        for (int ji = 1; ji <= n; ji++) {
                            for (int jj = 1; jj <= n; jj++) {
                                if (shortest[ii][ij][ki][kj] + shortest[ki][kj][ji][jj] < shortest[ii][ij][ji][jj]) {
                                    shortest[ii][ij][ji][jj] = shortest[ii][ij][ki][kj] + shortest[ki][kj][ji][jj];
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        int src = n * n * 2 + 1;
        int dest = n * n * 2 + 2;
        cap = new int[dest + 1][dest + 1];
        vis = new int[dest + 1];

        // source and sink edges
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                if (Character.isDigit(scien[i][j])) {
                    cap[src][getnode(i, j, n)] = scien[i][j] - '0';
                }
                if (Character.isDigit(reac[i][j])) {
                    cap[n * n + getnode(i, j, n)][dest] = reac[i][j] - '0';
                }
            }
        }

        // scientist to reactant edges
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                if (Character.isDigit(scien[i][j]) && scien[i][j] > '0') {
                    for (int ki = 1; ki <= n; ki++) {
                        for (int kj = 1; kj <= n; kj++) {
                            if (Character.isDigit(reac[ki][kj]) && reac[ki][kj] > '0') {
                                if (shortest[i][j][ki][kj] <= t && canreach(i, j, ki, kj, infx, infy, n, scien)) {
                                    cap[getnode(i, j, n)][n * n + getnode(ki, kj, n)] = 1000;
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        int mflow = 0;
        int ret;
        while ((ret = aug(src, dest, 1000)) > 0) {
            mflow += ret;
            iter++;
        }
        System.out.println(mflow);
        sc.close();
    }

    private static int getnode(int x, int y, int n) {
        return (x - 1) * n + (y - 1);
    }

    private static int aug(int cnode, int dest, int bneck) {
        if (cnode == dest) {
            return bneck;
        }
        if (vis[cnode] == iter) {
            return 0;
        }
        vis[cnode] = iter;
        for (int i = 0; i <= dest; i++) {
            if (cap[cnode][i] > 0) {
                int cret = aug(i, dest, Math.min(bneck, cap[cnode][i]));
                if (cret > 0) {
                    cap[cnode][i] -= cret;
                    cap[i][cnode] += cret;
                    return cret;
                }
            }
        }
        return 0;
    }

    private static boolean canreach(int sx, int sy, int tx, int ty, int ix, int iy, int n, char[][] scien) {
        int[][] reach = new int[n + 2][n + 2];
        int[][] treach = new int[n + 2][n + 2];
        reach[sx][sy] = 1;
        reach[ix][iy] = 2;
        int iters = 100;
        while (iters-- > 0) {
            expand(1, reach, treach, n, scien);
            if (reach[tx][ty] == 1) return true;
            expand(2, reach, treach, n, scien);
            if (reach[tx][ty] == 2) return false;
        }
        return false;
    }

    private static void expand(int val, int[][] reach, int[][] treach, int n, char[][] scien) {
        int[] dx = {1, 0, -1, 0};
        int[] dy = {0, 1, 0, -1};
        // copy reach to treach
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                treach[i][j] = reach[i][j];
            }
        }
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                if (treach[i][j] == val) {
                    for (int k = 0; k < 4; k++) {
                        int ni = i + dx[k];
                        int nj = j + dy[k];
                        if (ni >= 1 && ni <= n && nj >= 1 && nj <= n) {
                            if (treach[ni][nj] < val && scien[ni][nj] != 'Y') {
                                reach[ni][nj] = val;
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}
